def aspis_core.field.ct.subtract_p (x : Std.U32) : Result Std.U32 := do
  let i ← lift (UScalar.cast_fromBool .U32 (x >= aspis_core.field.P))

  ok (core.num.U32.wrapping_sub x i1)

@[rust_fun "aspis_core::field::ct::reduce64"]
def aspis_core.field.ct.reduce64 (x : Std.U64) : Result Std.U32 := do
  let i ← lift (UScalar.cast .U64 aspis_core.field.P)
  let i1 ← lift (x &&& i)
  let i2 ← lift (Std.U64.wrapping_shr x 31#u32)
  let x1 ← lift (Std.U64.wrapping_add i1 i2)
  let i3 ← lift (UScalar.cast .U64 aspis_core.field.P)
  let i4 ← lift (x1 &&& i3)
  let i5 ← lift (Std.U64.wrapping_shr x1 31#u32)
  let x2 ← lift (Std.U64.wrapping_add i4 i5)
  let i6 ← lift (UScalar.cast .U32 x2)
  aspis_core.field.ct.subtract_p i6

/-- [aspis_core::field::{aspis_core::field::CM31}::mul]:
    Source: 'crates/aspis-core/src/field.rs', lines 306:4-306:39
    Name pattern: [aspis_core::field::{aspis_core::field::CM31}::mul]
    Visibility: public -/
@[rust_fun "aspis_core::field::{aspis_core::field::CM31}::mul"]
def aspis_core.field.CM31.mul
  (self : aspis_core.field.CM31) (rhs : aspis_core.field.CM31) :
  Result aspis_core.field.CM31
  := do
  let m0 ← aspis_core.field.M31.mul self.a rhs.a
  let m1 ← aspis_core.field.M31.mul self.b rhs.b
  let i := self.a
  let i1 ← lift (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from i)
  let i2 := self.b
  let i3 ← lift (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from i2)
  let i4 ← lift (Std.U64.wrapping_add i1 i3)
  let i5 := rhs.a
  let i6 ← lift (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from i5)
  let i7 := rhs.b
  let i8 ← lift (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from i7)
  let i9 ← lift (Std.U64.wrapping_add i6 i8)
  let i10 ← lift (Std.U64.wrapping_mul i4 i9)
  let m2 ← aspis_core.field.M31.reduce_u64 i10
  let m ← aspis_core.field.M31.sub m0 m1
  let m3 ← aspis_core.field.M31.sub m2 m0
  let m4 ← aspis_core.field.M31.sub m3 m1
  ok { a := m, b := m4 }


#print axioms aspis_core.field.CM31.mul
end PV_B2_C_WeightsNative

  (self : aspis_core.field.CM31) (rhs : aspis_core.field.CM31) :
  aspis_core.field.CM31
  :=
  let m0 := aspis_core.field.M31.mul self.a rhs.a
  let m1 := aspis_core.field.M31.mul self.b rhs.b

  let i1 := (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from i)
  let i2 := self.b
  let i3 := (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from i2)

  let i5 := rhs.a
  let i6 := (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from i5)
  let i7 := rhs.b
  let i8 := (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from i7)

  let i10 := (Std.U64.wrapping_mul i4 i9)
  let m2 := aspis_core.field.M31.reduce_u64 i10
  let m := aspis_core.field.M31.sub m0 m1
  let m3 := aspis_core.field.M31.sub m2 m0
  let m4 := aspis_core.field.M31.sub m3 m1
  { a := m, b := m4 }

  let z11 ← Array.update z 7#usize q30
  let q31 ← Array.index_usize z11 6#usize
  let q32 ← aspis_core.field.QM31.sub aspis_core.field.QM31.ONE q31
  let z12 ← Array.update z11 6#usize q32
  ok (Array.make 3#usize [ z, z10, z12 ])

end PV_B2_C_WeightsNative

-- Component: PV_B2_C_ArrayTotal.lean
section
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace PV_B2_C_ArrayTotal
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

def Total {α : Type} (r : Result α) : Prop := ∃ x, r = ok x

theorem bind {α β : Type} (r : Result α) (k : α → Result β)
    (hr : Total r) (hk : ∀ x, Total (k x)) : Total (r >>= k) := by
  obtain ⟨x,hx⟩ := hr
  obtain ⟨y,hy⟩ := hk x
  exact ⟨y,by simp only [hx,bind_tc_ok,hy]⟩

theorem read {α : Type} {n : Usize} (xs : Array α n) (i : Usize)
    (h : i.val < n.val) : Total (Array.index_usize xs i) := by
  obtain ⟨x,hx,_⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
    (Array.index_usize_spec xs i (by
      change i.val < xs.val.length
      simpa only [xs.property] using h))
  exact ⟨x,hx⟩

theorem write {α : Type} {n : Usize} (xs : Array α n) (i : Usize) (x : α)
    (h : i.val < n.val) : Total (Array.update xs i x) := by
  obtain ⟨ys,hy,_⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
    (Array.update_spec xs i x (by
      change i.val < xs.val.length
      simpa only [xs.property] using h))
  exact ⟨ys,hy⟩

theorem borrow {α : Type} {n : Usize} (xs : Array α n) (i : Usize)
    (h : i.val < n.val) : Total (Array.index_mut_usize xs i) := by
  obtain ⟨x,hx⟩ := read xs i h
  exact ⟨(x,xs.set i),by simp only [Array.index_mut_usize,hx,bind_tc_ok]⟩

def RustOk {α ε : Type} (r : Result (core.result.Result α ε)) : Prop :=
  ∃ x, r = ok (.Ok x)

theorem bind_rust {α β ε : Type} (r : Result α)
    (k : α → Result (core.result.Result β ε))
    (hr : Total r) (hk : ∀ x, RustOk (k x)) : RustOk (r >>= k) := by
  obtain ⟨x,hx⟩ := hr
  obtain ⟨y,hy⟩ := hk x
  exact ⟨y,by simp only [hx,bind_tc_ok,hy]⟩
#print axioms bind
#print axioms read
#print axioms write
#print axioms borrow
#print axioms bind_rust
end PV_B2_C_ArrayTotal

end

set_option autoImplicit false

open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result PV_B2_C_ArrayTotal
abbrev K := PV_B2_C_Carrier.aspis_core.field.QM31

theorem double (x : K) : Total (PV_B2_C_WeightsNative.host_weights.double x) := by
  simp only [PV_B2_C_WeightsNative.host_weights.double,
    PV_B2_C_FieldTotal.QM31_mul,PV_B2_C_FieldTotal.QM31_add,PV_B2_C_FieldTotal.QM31_sub,
    bind_tc_ok]
  exact ⟨_,rfl⟩

/-- Every raw ten-element alpha array yields the copied three statement points.
This is source totality; it does not assert field validity of malformed limbs. -/
theorem points (alpha : Array K 10#usize) :
    Total (PV_B2_C_WeightsNative.host_weights.state_only_statement_points alpha) := by
  simp only [PV_B2_C_WeightsNative.host_weights.state_only_statement_points,
    PV_B2_C_FieldTotal.QM31_mul,PV_B2_C_FieldTotal.QM31_add,PV_B2_C_FieldTotal.QM31_sub,
    bind_tc_ok]
  repeat' first
    | exact ⟨_,rfl⟩
    | exact read _ _ (by decide)
    | exact write _ _ _ (by decide)
    | apply PV_B2_C_ArrayTotal.bind
    | (intro x; cases x)
#print axioms double
#print axioms points
end PV_B2_C_WeightsTotal

end
end
